info.name: LiteCore
info.summary: Open ODT files from Files in the LiteCore WebAssembly editor. M3 skeleton.
info.description: M3 skeleton of study_LiteCore's Nextcloud app. The editor runs entirely in the browser (LibreOffice core compiled to WebAssembly); the server only serves files. Shape = M3 gate 0's E1h: a dedicated route under Nextcloud's header, cross-origin isolated, every engine script served with COEP by PHP.
info.author: study_LiteCore
